checks.detail: Paste rows below the header into the Tree Protection & Mitigation Calculator > Tree Inventory (row 7+). Unlisted species map to "Other / unlisted species". Blank Y/N cells are treated by the calculator as not "Y" and blank % as 0, so fill them in before relying on results. The "Proposed action" column is intentionally blank: this app does not record proposed actions; the column is kept only so the paste lines up column-for-column with the calculator's 13 inputs (enter actions in the calculator if needed).
